name: week
title: Document production week
subtitle: Read-only work queue. Change records through the agent.

sections.title: Due work
sections.sql: select name,template,owner,due_date,readiness,privacy from job_register where status='open' order by due_date

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select name,owner,issue from attention order by name,issue

sections.title: Template approval
sections.sql: select name,owner,current_version,readiness,review_due from template_register order by name

sections.title: Output evidence
sections.sql: select name,template,version,data_version,decision,superseded from output_register order by created_at desc

sections.title: Workload
sections.sql: select * from owner_workload order by overdue desc,owner

sections.title: Retention decisions
sections.sql: select name,owner,status,retention_review from jobs where privacy='personal' order by retention_review nulls first
